quarterly_data.quarter: Simplo Technology AGM handbook: 2025 Business Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (2025 Business Report): data center backup batteries (BBUs) are seeing a significant increase in demand because large cloud service providers (CSPs) are investing heavily in AI servers, and AI servers require several times more BBUs than traditional servers; Simplo's BBU product line experienced strong growth in 2025, becoming a key profit driver.

quarterly_data.quarter: Simplo Technology AGM handbook: 2025 Business Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: demand for 5G, smart cloud and public cloud is driving the shift from lead-acid to lithium-ion batteries in large data centers; Simplo has invested in this field for many years and 'maintains close collaborations with leading international brands' (not named), which management expects to be a significant growth engine in the coming years. 2025 R&D spending NT$2,141,911 thousand (2.61% of sales) went to high-voltage, high-power battery backup systems (architecture and safety-tripping evaluation, insulation-risk simulation, hardware circuitry and firmware).

quarterly_data.quarter: Simplo Technology AGM handbook: 2025 Business Report (05-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 outlook (Business Plan): the company anticipates a slight increase in overall sales performance in 2026 compared to 2025; BBU products are expected to benefit from AI applications and higher cloud-service-provider capital expenditure, boosting lithium battery module shipments; global notebook demand is expected to remain similar to last year, with a possible 2026 memory supply shortage that could impact shipments; for new businesses (two-wheeled EVs, data center backup power, drones) management is 'cautiously optimistic'.
